title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: available in the US Department of Defense (DoD) cloud
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, government-cloud default, licensing qualifications and all six control surfaces are supported. It correctly distinguishes connector availability from the separate Copilot Search documentation that still lists DoD connectors as unavailable.

claims.claim: Copilot connectors are available for the US Department of Defense environment.
claims.quote: "title": "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot connectors are available for U.S. Department of Defense environment"; "status": "Launched"

claims.claim: Connectors integrate external data into Microsoft Graph to improve Copilot responses and discoverability.
claims.quote: Copilot connectors enable organizations to integrate content from  other external data sources into Microsoft Graph, improving Copilot’s intelligence, contextual responses, and content discoverability

claims.claim: Synced connectors ingest and index external content into Microsoft Graph.
claims.quote: Synced connectors ingest and index external content into Microsoft Graph.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Synced connectors index content on a recurring schedule.
claims.quote: Synced connectors index content from an external data source into the Microsoft 365 substrate on a recurring schedule.

claims.claim: Federated connectors retrieve source content in real time through MCP.
claims.quote: Federated connectors retrieve content in real time by using Model Context Protocol (MCP) without indexing data into Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: Federated connectors do not index the source content into Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: External connections and partner connectors are not enabled by default for government clouds, so the default is off.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The service description does not describe how government-cloud external connections and partner connectors are enabled.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors government clouds external connections partner connectors not enabled by default how enable DoD. Read the full cited Microsoft Copilot service description; its connector footnote states the default but gives no enablement procedure.

claims.claim: Configuring and deploying connectors requires an AI administrator in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: To configure and deploy Copilot connectors, you must be an AI administrator in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The deployment route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Connectors > Connectors > Gallery > data source > Create.
claims.quote: choose Copilot > Connectors. On the Connectors tab, in the left pane, choose Gallery, and select the data source you want to connect; Choose Create to deploy the connection.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/external/connections creates a connection for custom connectors.
claims.quote:
Create a new externalConnection object.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/external/connections

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The deployment steps allow deployment to a subset of users for validation before broader rollout.
claims.quote: Deploy the connector to a subset of users for validation before a broader rollout.

claims.claim: Choosing Create deploys the connection and starts indexing using default settings.
claims.quote: Choose Create to deploy the connection. The connector begins indexing content using default settings.

claims.claim: The gallery access route is Copilot > Connectors > Connectors > Gallery > data source > Custom setup > Users > Access Permissions.
claims.quote: choose Copilot > Connectors; On the Connectors tab ... choose Gallery, and select the data source; select Custom setup; On the Users tab, under Access Permissions, choose whether indexed data is visible to:

claims.claim: PUT /v1.0/external/connections/{connection-id}/items/{item-id} creates a custom connector item with an acl access control list.

claims.claim: Data imported through Copilot connectors becomes Customer Data under Microsoft's terms.
claims.quote: Data imported into your Microsoft 365 services using Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors will be "Customer Data" under the Product Terms, Data Protection Addendum, and Microsoft's enterprise data obligations.

claims.claim: Indexed external content is stored in the Microsoft 365 tenant.
claims.quote: External content is stored securely in your tenant, and users only see what they're allowed to access.

claims.claim: The organisation is responsible as data controller for connector functionality.
claims.quote: As the data controller, you're solely and exclusively responsible for: a) the Connector Functionality;

claims.claim: The organisation is responsible for complying with third-party rights, licences and obligations.
claims.quote: using the Microsoft 365 Copilot connector in compliance with any third-party rights, licenses, and obligations.

claims.claim: Incremental crawls do not support permission updates.
claims.quote: Incremental crawls don't support permission updates.

claims.claim: A full crawl is needed to bring source permission changes into the index.
claims.quote:
Full crawl: Syncs all data at scheduled intervals.
Incremental crawls don't support permission updates. Run full crawls periodically to maintain sync accuracy.

claims.claim: Synced connectors require data source credentials such as API keys or service account tokens.
claims.quote: Data source authentication credentials, such as API keys or service account tokens.

claims.claim: Prebuilt synced connectors require administrator access to the external service.
claims.quote: for prebuilt synced connectors (such as Google Drive, Confluence, ServiceNow), you must have admin access to the external service (Google Workspace Super Admin, Confluence Admin).

claims.claim: The default identity mapping matches email to UserPrincipalName or Mail in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: By default, the system maps users by matching their email to UserPrincipalName or Mail in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Administrators can supply a custom identity mapping formula.
claims.quote: In the Map Identities section, you can provide a custom mapping formula.

claims.claim: For an IP-firewalled source, the published usdodcentral IPv4 range is 57.17.40.192/26.
claims.quote:
If your data source uses IP firewall rules, allow access to the Copilot connectors service by permitting the following IP ranges.
| usdodcentral | 57.17.40.192/26 (64)

claims.claim: The published usdodeast IPv4 range is 52.181.74.64/26.
Administrators can configure the sync schedule of synced connectors.
claims.quote: On the Sync tab, you can configure how often data syncs between the source and the connector index.

claims.claim: Enabling connectors can authorise sending Customer Data to third-party services, subject to configuration.
claims.quote: By enabling Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors, you authorize Microsoft to, subject to your configurations: ... send your Customer Data and Personal Data ... to third-party services;

claims.claim: Enabling connectors can authorise modification of data in third-party services, subject to configuration.
claims.quote: By enabling Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors, you authorize Microsoft to, subject to your configurations: ... 4) modify data in third-party services
